ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＺＺ』　赤いキュベレイＭｋ－II プルツー専用機、ＨＧＵＣで初登場！
新生-ＲＥＶＩＶＥ-ＨＧＵＣキットで、プルツー操るキュベレイＭｋ-IIを１／１４４初キット化！（※）
（※）限定発売アイテムを除く
印象的なカラーを成形色で再現し、３本のビーム照射を再現するサーベルを新規造形で付属！
●　劇中に登場するカラーを成形色で再現！
●　３本のビーム刃をジョイントするサーベルグリップを新規型で再現！！
●　Ｍｋ-II特有の肩部マーキングもシールで再現！
●　キットは、新生-ＲＥＶＩＶＥ-ＨＧＵＣ！
より洗練されたプロポーションをもち、可動域の幅を広げ、劇中のさまざまなポージングの演出が可能。
付属武装  ：  ビーム・サーベル

en: "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" Red Qubeley Mk-II Pluto exclusive machine makes its first appearance in HGUC!
New-REVIVE-HGUCKit is the first 1/144 kit of Qubeley Mk-II that can be operated by pull-two! (*)
(*) Excluding limited release items
The impressive colors are reproduced with molded colors, and a newly molded saber that reproduces the irradiation of three beams is included!
● Reproduce the colors that appear in the play with molded colors!
● Reproduce the saber grip that joints three beam blades with a new type! !
● The shoulder markings unique to Mk-II are also reproduced with Seal!
● Kit is a new-REVIVE-HGUC!
It has more sophisticated proportions and a wider range of motion, allowing for various poses in the play.
Attached weapon: Beam saber
★Linked item CHECK!! (sold separately)★
Compatible with the funnel effect set for HGUC 1/144 Qubeley (Premium Bandai sales item).
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
